command:
set -eu
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/fleet-https-server.py >/dev/null <<'FLEET_PY'
#!/usr/bin/python3
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import ssl

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path != "/health":
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        body = b"node2 fleet https ok\n"
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        return

server = HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8443), Handler)
server.socket = ssl.wrap_socket(
    server.socket,
    certfile="/etc/fleet-https/server.crt",
    keyfile="/etc/fleet-https/server.key",
    server_side=True,
)
server.serve_forever()
FLEET_PY
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/fleet-https-server.py
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/fleet-https.service >/dev/null <<'FLEET_UNIT'

Description=Fleet internal HTTPS service
After=network.target

[Service]

User=nobody
Group=nogroup
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/sbin/fleet-https-server.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
FLEET_UNIT

sudo systemctl is-active fleet-https.service
sudo systemctl is-enabled fleet-https.service
